sourceNotes.rawContent: Capture the romance of Paris with this chic gold-toned Eiffel Tower bracelet. Featuring shimmering crystal accents, this high-fashion statement piece adds a touch of wanderlust to any outfit. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after use.
